text.title: North Star Metric Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the NSM decision record: at least three candidates scored on the same five criteria, one chosen NSM that counts a customer value event (never revenue, signups, pageviews, sessions or undifferentiated MAU) and is the highest-scoring candidate or says why not, a computable definition (events, unit, window, threshold, inclusions, exclusions, dashboard URL), a cohort validation above versus below the threshold with size, period, both retention rates and the delta, every runner-up placed as an input metric or rejected with a reason, three to five input metrics along breadth, depth, frequency and efficiency each with an owning team, current value and target, at least one gaming vector with its guard, and change control with the previous record, the series-break date and a review date within a year. Validator at scripts/validate-north-star-metric.py enforces it, including the score sums, the highest-candidate rule, the retention delta, runner-up coverage and the review interval.

required.field: product the NSM is adopted for

3 or more, each `name`, `counts` (value_event, revenue, signups, registered_users, pageviews, sessions, mau), `scores` on customer_value, leading_indicator_of_revenue, actionable_within_quarter, understandable_without_data_team, measurable_today (1 to 5 each) and `total` = their sum (r-candidates-scored-against-criteria)

`name` of one candidate whose `counts` is value_event, `is_highest_scoring`, and `not_highest_because` when it is not (r-nsm-counts-value-delivered, r-candidates-scored-against-criteria, r-single-nsm)

`events[]` counted, `unit` users / accounts / teams / transactions, `window` daily / weekly / 28_day, `threshold`, `inclusions[]`, `exclusions[]` (internal accounts, test data, ...), `dashboard_url` (r-nsm-definition-computable)

`method` above_vs_below_threshold_cohort, `cohort_size`, `period_start`, `period_end`, `outcome` retained or converted_to_paid, `rate_above`, `rate_below`, `delta` = rate_above - rate_below, `result` yes, `run_date` (r-nsm-validated-against-retention)
every candidate that is not the chosen NSM, with `disposition` input_metric (and the same name in `input_metrics`) or rejected with `rejection_reason` (r-single-nsm)
3 to 5, each `name`, `dimension` breadth / depth / frequency / efficiency, `owning_team`, `current_value`, `target`, `movable_within_quarter` true (r-input-metrics-tree)

1 or more, each `vector` (paid_signups, notification_spam, internal_or_bot_activity, threshold_lowering, other) with `guard.kind` (definition_exclusion, paired_quality_metric, paired_retention_metric, threshold_review_rule) and `guard.detail`; `inflatable_by_spend_alone` false (r-nsm-resists-gaming)
`previous_record` null or a reference, `series_break_date` when a previous record exists, `next_review_date` at most 365 days after `decided_on` (r-nsm-change-is-a-new-record)

forbidden.pattern: `chosen_nsm.name` pointing at a candidate whose `counts` is revenue, signups, registered_users, pageviews, sessions or mau — revenue-or-signups-as-nsm
a `definition` without `events`, `threshold`, `exclusions` or `dashboard_url`, or a `window` that is not daily, weekly or 28_day — uncomputable-definition
`validation.result` other than yes, missing `cohort_size`, `rate_above` or `rate_below`, or a `delta` that is not their difference — unvalidated-correlation-claim
a second NSM anywhere in the record (a secondary, a co-primary, a runner-up with no disposition), or `runner_ups` that does not cover every non-chosen candidate — two-north-stars
fewer than 3 or more than 5 `input_metrics`, an input without `owning_team`, `current_value` and `target`, or `movable_within_quarter` false — nsm-without-input-tree
`gaming_risks` empty, a vector without a guard, or `inflatable_by_spend_alone` true — gamed-nsm
fewer than 3 candidates, a candidate `total` that is not the sum of its five scores, or `is_highest_scoring` false with no `not_highest_because` (r-candidates-scored-against-criteria)
a `previous_record` with no `series_break_date`, or `next_review_date` more than a year after `decided_on` (r-nsm-change-is-a-new-record)

example.note: The chosen candidate counts project_completed per team per week, scores 24 of 25 and is the highest; every score total is the sum of its five criteria; the cohort of 4,200 teams retained at 0.62 above the threshold against 0.21 below, delta 0.41; all three runner-ups are placed; four inputs cover breadth, depth, frequency and efficiency; the review is 360 days after the decision.

Two candidates; MRR is chosen while its total 22 is not the sum of its scores and no reason is given for not being the highest; the definition counts no event in dollars over a monthly window with no threshold, no exclusions and no dashboard; the validation is not the above-vs-below cohort, has no cohort, no delta and is inconclusive; the runner-up is a secondary NSM; one input on a revenue dimension owned by everyone that nobody can move; no gaming vector and inflatable by spend; a previous record with no series-break date and a review two and a half years out.

list.item: At least three candidates, each `total` equal to the sum of its five scores; the chosen candidate's `counts` is value_event and it is the highest total or `not_highest_because` says why.
The definition names events, unit, window, threshold, at least one exclusion and a dashboard URL; two analysts would return the same number.
`validation.delta` = `rate_above` - `rate_below`, `result` is yes, and cohort size, period and run date are stated.
Every candidate other than the chosen one appears in `runner_ups`; those placed as input_metric appear by name in `input_metrics`.
Three to five inputs, each with an owning team, current value, target and movable within a quarter.
At least one gaming vector with a guard; `inflatable_by_spend_alone` false; `next_review_date` within 365 days of `decided_on`; a previous record carries a series-break date.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (score sums, chosen candidate is value_event and highest unless explained, retention delta and result yes, runner-up coverage and input placement, review within a year).
